texts.zh:
很棒。你在星系地图中就能看到，我们帝国的疆界已经拓展到了这个刚刚建好恒星基地的£system£恒星系上了。

新建的恒星基地只是一座哨站，只有非常有限的防御能力，没有安装模组和£building£建筑的空间。因此，这些没有升级过的哨站是不会显示在总览中的。

升级恒星基地；

£dot_green£在星系地图点击恒星系
£dot_green£选中恒星基地
£dot_green£点击升级按钮
texts.en:
Excellent. As you can see on the Galaxy Map, the borders of our empire have expanded to include the £system£ System where we built our new Starbase.

A newly built Starbase acts as an Outpost, with limited defensive capabilities and no room for Modules and £building£ Buildings. As such, it does not yet appear in the outliner until it has been upgraded.

To upgrade a Starbase;

£dot_green£ Click the system on the Galaxy Map
£dot_green£ Select the Starbase
£dot_green£ Click on the Upgrade button
